claim: Respiratory chain dysfunction leads to increased reliance on glycolysis as a source of ATP

claim: Respiratory chain dysfunction leads to dependence on pyruvate to support aspartate biosynthesis

claim: Respiratory chain dysfunction leads to inability to synthesize pyrimidines

claim: Cells activate serine biosynthesis in response to mtDNA depletion

claim: Cells activate transsulfuration in response to mtDNA depletion
source: First, generating hypotheses with metabolic, proteomic, and transcriptional profiling and following these observations up with focused validation experiments, we report that cells activate serine biosynthesis and transsulfuration in response to mtDNA depletion
